title: Moorbad Flirsch am Arlberg
highlights: Natural moor bath peacefully located at the edge of the forest in the Stanz valley
Beneficial moor water with soothing effects on skin and joints
Kneipp facility and manicured sunbathing lawn with mountain views
Tranquil oasis of relaxation well away from Arlberg main transit routes
kurzbeschreibung: Moorbad Flirsch in the Stanzer Tal is a soothing natural moor bath with Kneipp facilities and stunning mountain scenery.
beschreibung:
Healing Moor Bath in Stanzer Tal

The Moorbad Flirsch is quietly nestled at the edge of the forest above the village of Flirsch am Arlberg. The peat-rich water of this small forest pond has been valued for generations for its soothing and regenerative qualities, offering a welcome, natural refreshment on hot summer days.

Kneipp Therapy and Relaxation

Alongside the moor pool, a well-tended Kneipp facility invites visitors to try water-treading and arm baths according to Sebastian Kneipp, stimulating circulation and reviving tired hiking legs. A sunny lawn with benches and unobstructed views of the Lechtaler Alpen makes the moor bath a popular haven for those seeking peace and recovery.
